stem:
Arjun watches different objects moving around him during the day.
Which of these is an example of linear motion?

options.text: The second hand of the wall clock moving around the dial.
Riya sliding straight down a slide in the park.
A ceiling fan blade spinning above Meena's head.
A football curving through the air after Kabir kicks it.

teacher.key_rationale: Linear motion is motion along a straight-line path. Sliding straight down a slide follows a straight path (B). The clock hand and fan blade are circular motion, and the curving football follows a curved path, so A, C and D are not linear motion.
